column1: # Rung 2: the nested one-shot limit (2026-10-31; docs/rung2_nest.md; the user).
# The ABM configured as Chapter 1's game: one simultaneous decision (TIMING=oneshot),
# head-count belief from the prior only, failed-bank stayers get L = 0 (insurance
# q 0), every runner paid (LIQUIDITY=unlimited), equal deposits (sigma 0), risk
# neutral, all or nothing, strict tie-break, uniform noise (eps_x = eps_y = 0.10,
# half-widths), point-mass lambda (Ch 1's omega_I, omega_C), a fixed shock of 10 of
# Grid and tolerance fixed BEFORE the runs (Walter, 2026-10-31): the 15 reference
# cells (mu 0/0.25/0.5/0.75/1 x lambda pairs 0.1/0.9, 0.2/0.8, 0.3/0.5) at two stale
# levels, y 0.5 and y 0.2 (at 0.5 the collectivists' (b) cutoffs lie outside the
# signals, so y 0.2 is what tests them); 250 runs per cell; depth 1,000.
# Criterion (Rahmandad-Sterman 2008): each type's (b_D) cutoff inside the ABM's
# run-clustered 95% interval, every cell; where (b) puts it outside the signals, the
# type's withdrawal count against (b_D)'s.
# Fire: scripts/run_arms.sh arms/rung2_nest.tsv --dry-run, then without.
# Read: python3 scripts/nest_bridge.py   (once; writes outputs/analysis/nest_bridge.csv)
#       python3 scripts/nest_cutoffs.py outputs/nest-y50 --y 0.5
#       python3 scripts/nest_cutoffs.py outputs/nest-y20 --y 0.2
